sourceChronology.historyFinding: Immediate predecessor 3189 applied 28.04.2013–31.12.2020. §§ 39, 41–43, 46, 48–52 retain the relevant procedural architecture. Latest change inserts § 52a accessible communication, not new counting rules.

Immediate predecessor 3830 applied 01.07.2016–31.12.2020 and already contains the GOG plus VwVG supplementary reference in § 21(1). Pre-01.07.2016 ZPO wording is not current law. Latest § 7a accessible communication does not change § 16 or § 21.

SG 154.100 is the law on organisation of courts and prosecution. No general procedural holiday or day-count provision was found in its complete current statutory body. Its reference does not import ZPO recesses.

§ 2 holiday list dates from the 2013 amendment. Latest 2020 change concerns sanctions. Twelve named days including Sunday holidays. No 2 January, Fasnacht, 24 or 31 December general procedural holiday.
Only § 147 is a researched analogy supported by VD.2019.196, not a positive tax-path authorisation. The provision does not prescribe the VwVG party/representative holiday canton.
Arts. 20–24 inspected. Article 20(3) expressly uses party or representative domicile/seat. No normal-post weekend opening shift in the enacted text.

Announced official consolidation inspected. Art. 20, 21a, 22 and 22a retain the researched computation rules. AS 2026 232 patent-related amendments do not change Art. 20. Different footnote numbers are not rule changes. No prospective normal-post weekend fiction imported.

Articles 1(1)(a), 2–3 and 5 cover forward day-count periods set by law, courts or administrative authorities. Swiss declaration in the official annex concerns Art. 11 holidays, not an Art. 1(2) administrative exclusion. No indefinite legal-stability claim.

calendarProposals.finding: Twelve named RLG holidays, Sundays independently non-working. Authority-seat binding for general cantonal administrative and internal OG routes follows DEC-2026-031, because OG and the analogously applied § 147(3) StG contain no express different territorial hook. This is a documented product/legal default, not a claim that OG expressly codifies a seat rule. No VwVG wholesale import.

§ 21(1) VRPG incorporates VwVG computation where applicable and not displaced. Art. 20(3) expressly selects canton of party or representative domicile/seat. No VRPG contrary rule was found. This is an explicit statutory reference exception to DEC-2026-031. Apply one positively established holiday canton, not an arbitrary union, first calendar hit or silent BS fallback. Ambiguous simultaneous seats, foreign seats or unestablished role remain qualification boundaries.
calendarProposals.nativeFixtureNote: TI is only the independently verified 8 December holiday counterexample. It is not a new TI administrative or social authorisation.

legalAnalysis.finding: Forward-day counting starts on the day following established legal opening. VD.2023.131 E. 2.1.4 and 2.2.1–2.2.2 confirms this for OG and VRPG, including legally qualifying publication despite § 16(1) wording. Weekends and holidays inside the count are counted. Only an end landing on a non-working day is shifted. General administrative ordered submissions additionally rest directly on EuFrÜb Art. 1(1)(a), 3 and 5, not an invented OG reference to VwVG.

§ 46 OG and § 16 VRPG require 10-day registration and 30-day reasons from the same legal opening. Registration does not restart the 30 days. VD.2022.111 confirms this directly. Transfer under § 42 OG / § 12 VRPG likewise is not itself a fresh opening of the challenged decision. A separate current judicial day-count order can be calculated only on its own positively established terms.

Internal § 46(3) OG permits extension of reasons on a justified request. Court § 16(2) permits an exceptional longer period. A request alone supplies neither permission nor a new deadline. An actually granted current forward-day order belongs in ordered-day paths. A granted fixed end date is kept in background and not redundantly calculated. The original statutory registration remains non-extendable.

§ 21(2) VRPG expressly excludes court recess. VD.2022.111 E. 3.3.2 confirms no recess in cantonal administrative and internal recourse proceedings. VwVG 22a does not override the express VRPG exception. The decision in VD.2016.84 supports the principle but is a supplemental older application, not the sole current normative basis.

§ 39 OG generally requires written decisions and notice of remedy, § 49(3) written recourse decisions. Actual receipt is not invariably legal opening. Service on a representative, service fiction, defective notice, non-personal/public opening and special notification regimes must be positively qualified. No GE-style Monday rebasing of ordinary Saturday post is inferred. Current ordinary physical receipt may be used only when independently confirmed to be the legally relevant opening.

A current valid authority-set forward-day submission in a general cantonal first-instance procedure is proposed as a calculation group. The legal existence, competence and wording of that particular order remain a fact precondition. The general counting and end-shift rule is supported by directly applicable EuFrÜb Art. 1(1)(a), 3 and 5, construed with the Swiss folgetag principle explicated in VD.2023.131. This does not pretend that every administrative deadline is regulated by OG § 46 or automatically opens a statutory remedy.

commonRequirements.reason: Only existing general procedures before cantonal bodies. Independent municipal legislation remains excluded.
No different federal/cantonal special procedural rule. No tax, procurement, social, political-rights or constitutional-review positive release.
Legal opening is positively established outside the calculator. Mere physical receipt cannot reconstruct representation, fiction, publication admissibility or defective notice.
No unresolved defective or misleading remedy notice, pending restitution or already interrupted/replaced period.

pathProposals.label: Angeordnete Tagesfrist im Erstverfahren
pathProposals.positiveScope: Existing valid current forward-day party submission order in the general initial cantonal procedure. No competence or special-law authorisation inferred.

pathProposals.label: Verwaltungsinterner Rekurs anmelden
pathProposals.positiveScope: Admissible general OG internal registration, including confirmed lawful publication as opening. No special-remedy duration inferred.

pathProposals.label: Verwaltungsinternen Rekurs begründen
pathProposals.positiveScope: Original 30-day reasons from the challenged decision's legal opening, not from registration, a later transfer or a mere extension request.

pathProposals.label: Angeordnete Eingabe im verwaltungsinternen Rekurs
pathProposals.positiveScope: Current reply, production, improvement or actually granted reasons order expressed as a forward-day period. A fixed end date is background only.

pathProposals.label: Rekurs beim Verwaltungsgericht anmelden
pathProposals.positiveScope: General court recourse registration. Separate appealability qualification for interim decisions is not replaced by a calculator.

pathProposals.label: Rekurs beim Verwaltungsgericht begründen
pathProposals.positiveScope: Original reasons period from the same decision opening. A court-granted exceptional longer current day-count order uses BS-COURT-ORDERED.

pathProposals.label: Gerichtlich angeordnete Tagesfrist
pathProposals.positiveScope: Current judicial improvement, reply, evidence or expressly granted reasons period in days. No recess and no automatic extension.

pathProposals.label: Abweisung eines Beiladungsantrags anfechten
pathProposals.positiveScope: Only the applicant's express § 23(1) remedy against refusal of joinder, not every procedural judicial order.

boundaries.reason: Different special procedural rule or wrong scope, including KESB, tax, procurement, social, political rights and constitutional review. No general 10/30 fallback.
Unestablished legal opening, unqualified physical receipt, uncertain fiction or publication. No silent rebasing or inference from a postal collection extension.
Defective notice, wrong remedy instruction, already interrupted/replaced period or restitution facts require their own legal assessment.
Registration, transfer or receipt confirmation used instead of legal opening of the challenged decision for original reasons period.
Extension merely requested or its actual granted terms/current triggering notice not established. Never append an assumed 20 or 30 days.
Statutory registration period is not changed by a request to extend reasons.
No valid current forward-day order established or special/non-submission action instead.
Party/representative holiday canton not positively established, ambiguous or foreign anchor, arbitrary list union, or authority-seat assumption in a court path.
Fixed end date, appointment, backwards period, cost/payment action or hour/week/month/year unit is not this forward-day submission model.

exclusions.reason: An additional ten-day route after refusal to withdraw a non-personally opened decision is expressly preserved, not silently treated as a universal reconsideration restart. This compound route is outside the first positive groups.

Challenge after the administration declares that it cannot grant the requested disposition requires its distinct legal action and communicated declaration. It is not inferred from an ordinary receipt field.

exclusions.provision: VwVG Art. 24 via VRPG § 21(1), StG § 147(5) analog in OG practice
exclusions.reason: Restitution exists but requires individual faultlessness, end of impediment and remedial act. No generic ordinary receipt calculation or fresh general remedy authorisation.
Internal delay/denial remedy is not bound to a fixed period. Court special requirements cannot be fabricated as the ordinary 10-day path.
Thirty days for authority transfer after reasons is an authority processing period, not a new party period from transfer.
Wrong cantonal authority filing and formal electronic filing safeguards remain documented. An end date does not certify timely filing, technical receipt or validity of ordinary email.
Cost advances, payment periods and fixed appointments are not rendered as redundant day calculators.

openDecisions.proposal: Accept the eight bounded positive groups and the same-trigger 10/30 split. Granted current day-count extensions are ordered paths. Fixed end dates remain background.

Accept authority-seat BS calendar for initial/internal routes under the documented DEC-031 default and separate explicit party/representative canton for court paths through VRPG § 21(1) / VwVG Art. 20(3).
Accept no general recess, qualified opening, the investigated exclusions and complete-day window 29.08.2026–31.12.2027. New legislative check remains required before promotion.
